question: Which background-estimation methods does analysis 2401.05299 use?

answer.text:
Analysis 2401.05299 uses the following background-estimation methods:

- $\chi^{2}$ compatibility test between unfolded distributions and predictions
- Asimov dataset closure and bias stress tests of the unfolding procedure
- Beeston-Barlow "lite" technique for limited MC sample-size statistical uncertainties
- Maximum-likelihood (profile likelihood) fit with Poisson/Gaussian terms and Beeston-Barlow-lite MC-stat nuisances
- Profile likelihood unfolding (PLU) for particle-level differential cross-sections
- Statistical bootstrap optimization of regularization strength $\tau$ via global correlation coefficient
- Tikhonov (second-derivative) regularization of unfolding

These methods are recorded in the graph as the statistical techniques used in the analysis.

question: How many object selection requirements does analysis 2011.07812 define?

answer.text:
Analysis 2011.07812 defines 18 object selection requirements. Here they are:

- \((pT_{\text{track}} - pT_{e})/pT_{e} > -0.5\)
- \(3 \text{ mm} < |d0| < 300 \text{ mm} \, (\text{signal electron})\)
- \(3 \text{ mm} < |d0| < 300 \text{ mm} \, (\text{signal muon})\)
- Calorimeter isolation < 15% of muon energy
- Calorimeter isolation < 6% of electron energy
- Combined ID+MS fit \(\chi^2/\text{nDOF} < 3\), \(\geq3\) precision MS layers, \(\geq1\) high-precision \(\phi\) measurement
- ID track \(\chi^2/\text{nDOF} < 2\) and \(\leq1\) missing hit after innermost hit
- MS segment window: \(|\eta_{\mu} + \eta_{\text{MSsegment}}| < 0.018\) and \(|(\phi_{\mu} - \phi_{\text{MSsegment}}) - \pi| < 0.25\)
- Standard identification algorithm with \(|d0|\) and hit-count requirements removed
- Track isolation < 4% of muon \(pT\)
- Track isolation < 6% of electron \(pT\)
- \(pT > 65 \text{ GeV} \, (\text{signal electron})\)
- \(pT > 65 \text{ GeV} \, (\text{signal muon})\)
- \(|d0| < 10 \text{ mm} \, (\text{standard tracking stage})\)
- \(|d0| < 300 \text{ mm} \, (\text{extended tracking stage})\)
- \(|eta| < 2.5\)
- \(|t0_{\text{avg}}| < 30 \text{ ns}\)

These requirements are directly quoted from the paper.
